# `pokerai.config`

Central paths and hyperparameters.

```{python}
#| label: show-config-paths
#| code-fold: true

from pokerai import config
import pandas as pd

pd.DataFrame(
    [
        {"Name": "REPO_ROOT", "Value": str(config.REPO_ROOT)},
        {"Name": "DATA_DIR", "Value": str(config.DATA_DIR)},
        {"Name": "HANDS_RAW", "Value": str(config.HANDS_RAW)},
        {"Name": "HANDS_CLEAN", "Value": str(config.HANDS_CLEAN)},
        {"Name": "TOKENIZER_DIR", "Value": str(config.TOKENIZER_DIR)},
        {"Name": "MODEL_GPT2_DIR", "Value": str(config.MODEL_GPT2_DIR)},
        {"Name": "MODEL_TRL_DIR", "Value": str(config.MODEL_TRL_DIR)},
        {"Name": "MODEL_BIGRAM_DIR", "Value": str(config.MODEL_BIGRAM_DIR)},
        {"Name": "HF_DATASET", "Value": config.HF_DATASET},
        {"Name": "WANDB_PROJECT", "Value": config.WANDB_PROJECT},
    ]
)
```

`GPT2Hyperparams` is a frozen dataclass exposing `as_dict()` for W&B configs.

# `pokerai.data`

| Function | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `to_line(question, answer)` | Flatten whitespace; join with comma |
| `clean_line(line)` | Normalize `CALL 0BB` / `FOLDxBB` |
| `fetch_hands(path)` | Download HF dataset → text file |
| `write_cleaned(lines, path)` | Apply cleaning and write |
| `load_text_split(path)` | HF `text` dataset + train/test split |
| `split_prompt_completion(text)` | Last-comma split |
| `encode_with_mask(text, tok, max_length)` | IDs + labels with action-only supervision |
| `train_tokenizer(...)` | Byte-Level BPE + HF wrapper |

# `pokerai.models`

| Symbol | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `Bigram` | Embedding table next-token model |
| `build_gpt2(tokenizer, hp)` | Random-init `GPT2LMHeadModel` |
| `default_gpt2_config_kwargs()` | Dict of default architecture sizes |

# `pokerai.training`

| Module | Entry | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `train_bigram` | `main()` | Action-pair CE; logs to W&B |
| `train_gpt2` | `main()` | Raw loop; masked labels |
| `train_trl` | `main()` | TRL SFT; `completion_only_loss` |
| helpers | `get_device()`, `load_tokenizer()` | Shared utilities |

# `pokerai.inference`

| Function | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `load_model(model_dir)` | Load GPT-2 + tokenizer from a checkpoint dir |
| `predict_action(state, model, tokenizer)` | Greedy generation of the action string |
| `main()` | argparse CLI |

# Tests

```bash
pytest -q
```

Primary coverage lives in `tests/test_data.py` (cleaning + mask encoding) and
`tests/test_config.py` (path / hyperparameter sanity).
